image_title: Department of Defense Rate Reduction Data
summary: This table presents the rate reduction data for various branches of the Department of Defense (DOD) from Fiscal Year (FY) 2002 to FY 2009. The data shows that 'All DOD' had a rate of 31.5 in FY 02, which decreased to 18.7 in FY 09, resulting in a rate reduction of 12.8 and a percent improvement of 41%. The Army's rate decreased from 29.3 to 17.8, with a reduction of 11.5 and a 39% improvement. The Navy's rate went from 39.8 to 21.2, achieving an 18.6 reduction and a 46% improvement. The Marines saw a significant drop from 73.8 to 36.7, with a 37.1 reduction and a 50% improvement. The Air Force's rate reduced from 25.6 to 16.5, resulting in a 9.1 reduction and a 36% improvement. Lastly, Defense Logistics decreased from 25.6 to 16.9, with an 8.7 reduction and a 34% improvement.
